name: grapheme-aware-min-length
notes: 3 flag-emoji grapheme clusters, but 6 runes / 12 UTF-16 code units — must pass on grapheme count, not a per-host string length. This is the exact case the brief flags: Java counts UTF-16 code units, Go counts bytes, so @maxLength/@minLength must live in the shared core, never reimplemented per language.
